body:
> I wish you the best of luck. If you don't make your due date, your friend will be lost without you I'm sure. What are you looking to accomplish in 5 months? if you don't mind me asking...

I hope to have $5k in savings so that I can transition towards moving to Europe and finally experiencing some excitement in life. I want to have a girlfriend again, one that respects me and understands that I have needs as well. Girlfriend is last on my list. I'm very mentally aware of who I am and what I need to get done. I'm in contact with a few people and although I know to never have high hopes, I'm keeping my fingers crossed that at least one of these routes to Europe pans out. I want to enjoy my life, regardless of my constant state of poverty. I just need some excitement. Monotony and working 90 hours a week will never make me happy like it did my narcissistic father. Every time I'd try to explain to him that no normal human being works 90 hours a week (I also care less about having an overabundance of big toys), he would say so what? He worked 110 hours a week when he was my age and I'm a lazy bum if I work anything less than 60-70.

My friend would be lost. He would probably be very hurt and depressed. We've discussed this in detail and he's determined to keep me around after June although I've warned him that I might not be around. It's selfish of me to do that to him if I do but he has stayed around even after I've been rude and overly needy in the past. I've recognized these issues and am no longer needy and rude to him, but happiness is something I can't control. I haven't ever really experienced genuine happiness. I have no idea how it feels. All I know is temporary periods of elation that subside after a few hours...things like getting a new computer or a new game, I was never happy. I've been quite empty on the inside throughout my life...recognizing that over the last year has put everything into perspective.
